decision.rationale: TXN-007838 (13903 minor units EUR at LARKSPUR GROCERS, MER-000073) is on card CRD-000191. It posted on 2026-09-16 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-30. That is 44 days, inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The authorisation behind it, AUTH-008053, shows entry mode CHIP, PIN verified true, fraud flag false and response APPROVED. Under unauthorised-chip-and-pin, a chip payment with the PIN verified and no fraud flag counts as made by the cardholder, because the card and the PIN were both there. This card also has two earlier approved purchases at the same merchant: TXN-007836 on 2026-07-25 and TXN-007837 on 2026-08-22. They support the finding but do not decide it. The cardholder says the card never left them, which fits a chip-and-PIN payment. The statement had no instructions in it.

proposed_actions.reason: The payment was made with your card's chip and your PIN was entered correctly, and nothing about it was flagged as suspicious. You have also made earlier purchases at this merchant with the same card. Under our policy, that means the payment is treated as made by you.
